We need to determine appropriate charge(s) from the lexicon for the fact.

Fact: Stone (石某) went to a hotel front desk, pretended to book a room, chatted, then at 11:50 he pretended to check in, asked Lin to go to workroom to get water, while Wang was at front desk, he stole cash of 9400 yuan placed at front desk and escaped.

This is theft (抢夺) of cash from hotel front desk. The lexicon includes "抢夺" (robbery?) Actually "抢夺" is listed as a charge. Also "盗窃" is listed. Need to decide which is appropriate. The act is taking cash from front desk, likely "抢夺" (robbery) because he used force? He used deception and took cash quickly. In Chinese criminal law, "抢夺" is a form of theft with violence or intimidation. The fact says he "抢走" the cash. So charge "抢夺". Also possibly "盗窃". But the lexicon includes both. Which is more appropriate? The fact: He pretended to check in, used deception, then took cash while staff not aware. This is "抢夺" (snatching). Usually "抢夺" is taking property by force or threat, but here maybe "抢夺" is appropriate. The lexicon includes "抢夺". So answer: [罪名]抢夺<eoa>.

Check if any other charges: "非法侵入住宅"? No. "非法获取公民个人信息"? No. "故意伤害"? No. So just one charge.

Thus final answer.
